_comment: UI text the game never passes through translation. The patch replaces the English source text itself (game data + scene files). Data fields take their Chinese from the merged zh_CN.po, with data_extra for values that have no po entry. Scene replacements must not be longer in UTF-8 bytes than the English; they are padded with trailing spaces.

data_extra.Hire a Farmhand I that unlocks automatio: 雇用农场帮工I后，凡是[b]所需农务等级低于 [color=orange]30[/color]级[/b]的农务操作，均可自动执行。雇用帮工需用葡萄酒支付报酬。
